item.title: Ice Cream Shop's 'I See Kareem' Song Gets Remixed, Goes Viral As A Dance Track On TikTok
item.description: I See Kareem is a viral video of ice cream shop worker Emad Alshalabi singing in front of his shop, "Ice cream, ice cream," which has been interpreted by many as sounding like "I see Kareem" due to his accent. Alshalabi started posting videos singing the song on TikTok and Instagram in March 2025. Late that year, the videos began going viral, inspiring memes and videos referencing Alshalabi, which became further popularized in January 2026. item.title: Somali-American Woman Wrongly Detained By ICE Becomes A Meme For 'Bananas And Rice' Speech
item.description: Bananas and Rice Girl refers to memes referencing a viral video of Somali woman Nasrah Ahmed, an American citizen, speaking about being assaulted and harassed by ICE agents, then detained for two days. During the speech, she says that being Somali is not just about eating bananas and rice and then awkwardly saying "bananas and rice" several more times while trying to describe what it's like to be Somali in America. item.title: Recent Conspiracy Theory Claims A Leviathan Is Waking Up Near Virginia And The Government Is Trying To Freeze It
item.description: Leviathan Waking Up Near Virginia refers to a conspiracy theory claiming that a leviathan, a mythological sea serpent or demon, is waking up in the ocean near Virginia, U.S. and the government created a snow storm to freeze it. The theory began in late January 2026 on Facebook when an altered Google Earth screenshot that shows a snake-like shape in the ocean east of Richmond, VA went viral. The claim spread that month, inspiring memes.

item.title: Osho's Infamous Quote About Democracy Finally Gets An Entry
item.description: But The People Are Retarded is a memorable quote and catchphrase said by controversial new religious movement leader and Indian philosopher Rajneesh Osho in a viral video about democracy uploaded to YouTube in early 2021. Over the following years, Osho's statement, particularly his unexpected usage of the slang term "retarded," became a meme as it was used as a reaction image and image macro around the internet, usually to call something or someone stupid, as well as to mock various things.
